entities.summary: Andrée Clair was a writer who was born in France as Renée Jung, and spent her later days in France, but is also associated with Niger. She studied Africa at the Ethnological Institute in the Sorbonne University. She was noted for her ethnographic study of Niger and writing children's books set in Africa. Her books include Bemba [An African Adventure]. Andrée Clair was a journalists & chroniclers from Malakoff (1916-05-06, Malakoff–2009-05-17). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
